Allen Buckley

Libertarian candidate for United States Senate, Georgia · Challenger

Attorney and certified public accountant (CPA)

Allen Buckley is an Atlanta-area attorney and CPA who has practiced for about forty years. The Libertarian Party of Georgia nominated him for U.S. Senate at its January 2026 state convention, and he qualified with the Secretary of State as the party's candidate. He has run for the U.S. Senate in Georgia several times before, including as the Libertarian nominee in 2004, 2008 and 2016 and as an independent in the 2020 special election.

Where Buckley stands

National debt and federal spending
Proposes reducing the national debt and says he has model legislation drafted and ready to introduce if elected.
Executive power
Supports limiting what his platform calls Executive branch abuses of power.
Immigration
Supports immigration reform as part of his platform.
Health care
Proposes opening up a competitive free market in health care and generally favors private-sector solutions.
